Capture date: 2026-11-13 UTC (2026-11-12 Pacific). Native capture of the built-in Person Account duplicate rule (plan 4a).
Org: one fresh 30-day Developer Edition scratch org with the PersonAccounts feature. Metadata and Tooling/REST update of MatchingRule and DuplicateRule were refused ("entity type cannot be updated"), so The maintainer activated Standard Person Account Matching Rule, then Standard Person Account Duplicate Rule, in Setup. Verified by SOQL before any case ran: MatchingRule Standard_PersonAccount_Match_Rule_v1_0 RuleStatus Active; DuplicateRule Standard_Person_Account_Duplicate_Rule IsActive true, SobjectSubtype PersonAccount (the business Standard_Account_Match_Rule_v1_0 and Standard_Account_Duplicate_Rule stayed active). The standard duplicate rule was then deactivated and reactivated by metadata deploy (a plain DuplicateRule deploy with isActive false and true works; only first activation of the matching rule needed Setup). Final SOQL after the last stage: every rule listed in frozen/rule-state-end.txt was active. The Dev Hub active scratch record went from 1 to 0 after deletion and the local target no longer resolves.
Frozen predictions: Glade 7b860d462 with GLADE_STANDARD_DUPLICATE_RULES=on, glade exec at API 67.0 on a project whose scratch definition lists PersonAccounts, before each native run (frozen/predicted-stage_pa.json, predicted-stage_pa_off.json, predicted-stage_pa_two.json). Glade leaves the built-in rule unenforced, so its Person Account predictions are exceptions or custom-rule-only results. paEdit and resultShape have no usable Glade prediction (SObjectException on Account.Ext__c; HandledException).
Groups: pa (paFields, paById, paEdit, crossSubtype, noRecordType, mixedList, byIdBatch, resultShape) with the built-in rule active; pa_off (mixedListOff, paFieldsOff) with the standard Person Account duplicate rule deactivated; pa_two (twoRules, resultShapeTwo, mixedListTwo, paFieldsTwo) after deploying the custom Person Account matching rule ProbePersonName and duplicate rule ProbePersonAlert (sort order 2) beside the active built-in rule (sort order 1).
Design: one helper method per case in PABehavior with exact synthetic names, emails, phones and mailing addresses; pairs are unique so no pair reaches another pair's seed. Seeds are inserted with allowSave, then find (by value) and insert(false), or findDuplicatesByIds on stored candidates. Records are labelled by ID inside Apex; IDs never leave Apex. paFields pairs: exact; fuzzy first name; initial; terminal surname swap; phone only; mailing address only; nothing shared; an exact positive control; an unrelated negative control. Exceptions are recorded as EX:type:message. The deliberately raised assertion rolled back each transaction.
Routes: APIs 62.0 and 67.0, anonymous and @IsTest, each run twice; helper and test classes redeployed per API and ApexClass.ApiVersion read back. The driver fails on Apex log truncation or exhaustion text, missing or incomplete frames, class API mismatch. All observations of each case are identical across API, route and repeat.
Not done: Person Account sharing and field access (4b) and edit-shape cases for Person Account are not in this org; custom Person Account rule edit behavior was captured earlier.
